data.gist: Donor-matched BMAX vs BMAC vs PBS injected 4 weeks after DMM in immunodeficient rats; BMAX improved swelling, knee bend, paw withdrawal, and OARSI scores, exceeding BMAC on some endpoints.
data.plain: Human marrow from one donor was processed two ways (standard BMAC or the ECM-retaining BMAX) and injected into knees of immunodeficient rats four weeks after surgical meniscus destabilization, versus saline. Over 8 weeks, BMAX reduced swelling and pain-related behaviors and improved cartilage histology, beating BMAC for femoral cartilage scores (p = 0.0243) and knee bend (p = 0.0090); both reduced medial subchondral trabecular separation on micro-CT. The authors conclude ECM preservation was associated with better outcomes and that maintaining the native niche may enhance efficacy.
